create_wandb_config_default: create a wandb_config dataclass instance with the default llama_cookbook project name
create_wandb_config_custom_entity: create a wandb_config with a custom entity name for team-based experiment tracking
configure_wandb_tags: configure a wandb_config with tags to categorize Llama training runs
configure_wandb_group: configure a wandb_config with a group name to organize related experiments
set_wandb_mode: set the wandb_config mode to disable or enable wandb logging during training
